rules.unknown: A value that is missing or not listed in a source's map becomes unknown, never a guess.
rules.no_labels: event_type is built only from activity fields (for example a service or protocol column), never from a label or attack-type column, so correlation cannot see the label through it (OD-21, CON-20).
rules.match: Exact match after trimming spaces and lower-casing the source value.

types.name: network_flow

sources.notes: Service names as documented in NUSW-NB15_features.csv (column 14, service); '-' means no service was recognised. Checked on 31 Oct 2026 against all four UNSW-NB15 CSVs: the 13 measured service values are exactly the 13 keys of this map ('-' 1,246,397 records, dns 781,668, http 206,273, ftp-data 125,783, smtp 81,645, ftp 49,090, ssh 47,160, pop3 1,533, dhcp 172, ssl 142, snmp 113, radius 40, irc 31).
